full_prompt_en: The image is a square color photograph of an industrial harbor at blue dusk. A broad wooden pier begins at the bottom edge and recedes diagonally toward the upper right. Weathered planks create many long parallel lines, their seams and worn surfaces visible in the foreground. Calm dark water lies to the left, reflecting distant rows of warm yellow-orange port lights as narrow vertical streaks. On the far shoreline, cranes and industrial structures stand in a blue haze. One large crane rises from the middle-right edge of the pier, its skeletal arm dark against the sky. A small person sits alone on a low object near the left side of the pier, facing the water or distant harbor. Their body catches a warm highlight but remains much smaller than the open deck. At the extreme right, a dark building edge frames a bright amber doorway, spilling light over the nearby planks. The sky is an even cyan-blue that gradually darkens toward the top. Fog softens the distant equipment and lights without obscuring their rhythm. Most of the frame is quiet empty space: sky, water, and broad timber walkway. Color is sharply divided between cool blue ambient light and isolated orange lamps. The image has fine photographic grain and modest surface softness; the planks and crane stay believable rather than turning into perfect geometry. The camera looks along the pier from a slightly elevated standing height. The receding boards and rail edge pull the eye toward cranes and distant glow. The solitary human figure gives scale and emotional weight to the large industrial setting. The photograph feels still, spacious, and contemplative, with wet-looking wood, harbor haze, and small warm lights defining the mood.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形彩色照片，记录蓝色黄昏中的工业港口。宽阔木码头从底边开始，斜向右上延伸。风化木板形成许多长平行线，前景可见板缝和磨损表面。左侧是平静深水，远处成排暖黄橙色港灯在水里拖出狭窄竖向反光。远岸吊车和工业结构立在蓝色雾中。码头中右侧升起一台大吊车，骨架般吊臂在天空前变深。一名小小人物独坐在码头左侧一处低物上，朝水面或远港看。身体接住暖亮点，却比空旷甲板小得多。最右侧，一道深色建筑边缘框住明亮琥珀色门口，光溢到附近木板上。天空是均匀青蓝色，越往顶端越暗。雾柔化远方设备和灯，却没有抹去它们的节奏。画幅大部分是安静空处：天、水与宽木道。颜色明确分成冷蓝环境光和孤立橙灯。照片有细颗粒和适度柔化；木板与吊车保持可信，没有变成完美几何。相机从稍高的站立视角沿码头望去。后退的板条和岸边引视线通向吊车与远处光晕。孤独人影给大型工业场景尺度与情绪重量。照片静止、宽阔且沉思，以似乎潮湿的木材、港雾和小暖灯定义氛围。
style_prompt_en: Dusk color photography separates cool blue ambient atmosphere from small pools of amber industrial light. Long parallel surface lines lead across a broad quiet foreground toward softened distant machinery. Water reflects lights as broken vertical marks, and mist reduces hard detail at the horizon. Nearby wood, concrete, or metal keeps visible wear and grain. A tiny solitary accent can establish scale within wide sky, open water, and constructed space. Illumination remains sparse; darkness and atmospheric blue do most of the work. The overall image feels spacious, restrained, and contemplative, with warm-cool contrast and gradual loss of detail creating depth.
style_prompt_zh: 黄昏彩色摄影把冷蓝环境空气与少数琥珀工业灯光池分开。长平行表面线穿过宽阔安静前景，引向被柔化的远方机械。水将灯反射成破碎竖纹，雾削弱地平线处硬细节。近处木、混凝土或金属保有磨损与颗粒。微小而孤立的重点可在宽天空、开放水面与人工空间中建立尺度。照明稀疏，黑暗与空气蓝承担主体。整体宽阔、克制且沉思，以冷暖反差和细节逐渐消失建立纵深。
theme_en: A solitary figure on a long wooden harbor pier at blue dusk
theme_zh: 蓝色黄昏时，一名孤独的人坐在长木港口码头上
name: Allan Sekula
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
